start: Member app, Offers card, the gym has an open offer, the member has a gym plan running today

steps.action: Open the Offers card and tap 'Join the offer', agree on the consent screen
user_sees: The card shows the member is in, with the last day of the window and 0 counted
must_not: A window longer than the offer's days

steps.action: Log workouts of 20+ minutes with 6+ sets on days with a check-in
user_sees: Counted days go up by one per matched day
must_not: A day with no check-in counted

steps.action: Reach 10 matched days in an offer that gives days by themselves
user_sees: The card shows the reward given and the plan's new last day

start: Member app, member earned the reward while no gym plan was running; offer gives days by themselves

steps.action: Renew at the desk, then open the Offers card
user_sees: The reward given on the renewed plan
must_not: The reward lost because no plan ran on the day it was earned

steps.action: Tap 'Join the offer' with no gym plan running today
user_sees: A message that a running plan is needed

steps.action: Tap 'Join the offer' after the last day to join, or after the gym stopped it
user_sees: A message that the offer is closed
must_not: The member joined a closed offer

steps.action: The phone sends 21 sends of days in one day, or days with no check-in
user_sees: The 21st refused as too many; days with no check-in not counted
must_not: A count sent by the phone trusted

start: Member app, in the offer with 4 counted days

user_sees: The card shows the member left; counted days gone
must_not: The dates kept on the server

steps.action: Tap 'Join the offer' again the same week
user_sees: Back in, with the same window end as before

start: Member app, member who has not joined any offer

steps.action: Log workouts for a month without joining
user_sees: Nothing about workouts leaves the phone for the offer

steps.action: Join, then leave the gym from the app
must_not: Exercise names, weights, sets, workout length or body weight stored by the gym
